title: Prior U.S. Treasury Curve-Move Context Audit
question: Does the latest strictly prior official U.S. Treasury 2-year and 10-year par-yield move define a broad parallel-rate-rise or parallel-rate-fall external context that materially separates strategy-period-centered stressed R and stop incidence from divergent-or-flat curve moves across the frozen six-strategy portfolio?
hypothesis: A same-direction daily repricing of both the policy-sensitive 2-year point and the long-duration 10-year point is a broad rates-market state. Parallel rises may pressure equity-index continuation while parallel falls may ease discount-rate pressure; either state is informative only if its association is material, economically concordant and broad across periods and strategies relative to mixed or flat curve moves.
why_now: Units 043-048 completed one durable macro allocation cycle 7→5→2→4→3→1. Program 2's latest VIX unit was invalid before economics, while its earlier scheduled-release unit closed validly with no event-window field. A fresh whole-map comparison therefore favors one distinct official-rates context over adjacent signal, weekday, RC4-management, sizing or meta follow-up.

context_anchor.definition: The two yield changes had opposite signs or either published change was exactly zero.

distinction_from_closed_work.scheduled_us_macro_event_exposure_041: Unit 041 classified held-at-release and post-entry windows around FOMC, CPI and employment releases. Unit 049 uses no event calendar, release clock, hold state or post-entry interval.

official_external_source.dataset: Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates
official_external_source.publisher_description: Official par yields are interpolated from the daily par yield curve using indicative bid-side Treasury market quotations obtained near 3:30 PM each trading day.

snapshot_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

immutable_portfolio_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only official source rows and hashes, 2-year/10-year signs, strictly-prior date linkage, exact component identity, birth event and fresh period were used. No close value, stressed R, stop association, centered effect, gate or verdict was accessed.

fixed_classification.record_order: Parse official Date as MM/dd/yyyy, require unique dates and finite published 2 Yr and 10 Yr values, then order ascending.
fixed_classification.strictly_prior_record: For a birth on server calendar date D, use the latest Treasury record whose date is strictly less than D. Do not use same-date data regardless of birth time.
fixed_classification.preceding_record: Compare that selected record only with the immediately preceding official Treasury record, which may cross a weekend, holiday or year boundary.
fixed_classification.DIVERGENT_OR_FLAT: All other joint sign states, including either exact zero.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full portfolio CSV row; state_sequence is not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each fresh period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, close-before-birth precedence, source path and source line.
fixed_reconstruction.exact_component_selection: Use only the six complete component_id keys in strategy_identity. Prefix, suffix, substring, wildcard and inferred-family selectors are prohibited.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE stores positive planned risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it and PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive with the active risk.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle; value_b is frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD and EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop-loss exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Close value_b divided by positive birth planned risk.
fixed_reconstruction.strategy_period_centering: Within each of the 24 strategy x P1-P4 cells, subtract the full-cell mean stressed R and stop rate from every lifecycle before variant aggregation. Every role is included in the full-cell mean.
fixed_reconstruction.variant_effect: For each variant, variant mean centered metric minus DIVERGENT_OR_FLAT mean centered metric.

fixed_metrics.role_context: Report all three raw role economics without allowing the comparator to pass or rescue a variant.
fixed_metrics.variant_contrast: For each variant report pooled centered R and stop differences, four period effects and six strategy effects.
fixed_metrics.period_contribution_share: Absolute period contribution to the pooled centered-R contrast divided by the sum of absolute contributions across four periods.
fixed_metrics.strategy_contribution_share: Absolute strategy contribution to the pooled centered-R contrast divided by the sum of absolute contributions across six strategies.

fixed_integrity_gate: All five Treasury files and all six portfolio files retain their listed bytes and hashes; Treasury has 1,161 unique finite records and portfolio data has 16,477 rows with zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reproduce exactly 1,160 source moves and all frozen move and birth role counts with zero unclassified birth.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles with strategy totals 272/206/805/118/238/594, 407.0477 USD 2x stressed net and 206 stop exits with zero overlap, pending, risk or close fault.
Reproduce every frozen period, strategy and strategy-period density.
Reconstruct exactly 24 finite strategy-period centering cells.

density: Variant and comparator each contain at least 150 pooled lifecycles.
Variant and comparator each contain at least 100 lifecycles in every period.
Variant and comparator each contain at least 30 lifecycles in every strategy.
Every strategy-period cell contains at least five variant and five comparator lifecycles.
information: Absolute variant-minus-comparator centered stressed-R difference is at least 0.10R.
Absolute variant-minus-comparator centered stop difference is at least 0.05.
The pooled channels are economically concordant: positive R requires negative stop difference, while negative R requires positive stop difference.
Return and stop differences each share their pooled sign in at least three of four periods.
Return and stop differences each share their pooled sign in at least four of six strategies.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one strategy more than 40% of the absolute centered-R contrast contribution.
fixed_variant_gates.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every density and information requirement passes. Zero is never counted as a sign.

fixed_bundle_gate.authority_limit: Consumed-data association only. A pass selects no entry filter, event exclusion, rate rule, size, priority, EA or Live action and cannot open an adjacent successor automatically.
